purpose: Canonical human-readable responsibility map for runtime organs. Execution authority remains in code and blueprint boundaries.

organs.memory: Persistent episodic/semantic memory access and storage.
organs.experience: Records meaningful execution outcomes as experiences.
organs.evaluator: Evaluates experiences and determines whether they provide a learning signal.
organs.knowledge_builder: Constructs knowledge candidates from accepted learning signals.
organs.consolidator: Consolidates eligible memory into durable representations.
organs.learning: Controlled dispatcher separating knowledge learning from capability learning.
organs.evolution: Controlled proposal, validation, approval and runtime evolution boundary.
organs.curiosity: Generates safe learning candidates from unresolved uncertainty and useful gaps.
organs.planner: Transforms approved goals or candidates into ordered plans.
organs.scheduler: Schedules bounded background and idle work.
organs.idle_loop: Drives autonomous work during idle periods through the normal organism path.
organs.skill_executor: Executes registered skills and returns outcomes to the experience path.
organs.skill_learner: Detects repeated verified capability and creates skill proposals.
organs.perception: Normalizes input and extracts structured perceptual information.
organs.cognitive_router: Selects NATIVE, HYBRID or LLM FALLBACK from available evidence/capability.
organs.brain: Commits cognitive results into structured decisions and coordinates the lifecycle.
organs.llm_bridge: Optional reasoning/synthesis capability and fallback; not the organism controller.
organs.semantic_understanding: Provides semantic interpretation and semantic-memory integration.
organs.runtime_evolution_adapter: Explicit allowlisted adapter through which approved runtime evolution is applied.
